_readme: Fixes applied to the SWU-DB data on every update (python -m swu_momir.data.cards). Rule for Ambush and Sentinel: a unit is tagged only if it can have the keyword itself, including conditionally ('this unit gains Sentinel while...'). Units that only give, remove, or refer to the keyword are not tagged. 'card' can be any printing of the unit. The update reports entries that no longer change anything, so they can be deleted.
